facts.en: Completed a certificate in Event Administration at Fictional Institute B16 in 2020.
facts.zh: 2020 年在虚构学院 B16 完成活动行政证书课程。

facts.en: Equipment booking coordinator at Fictional Event Collective B16, 2020-10 to 2026-07.
facts.zh: 2020-10 至 2026-07，任虚构活动合作组织 B16 设备预订协调员。

facts.en: Scheduled pickup windows for rented event equipment using a shared spreadsheet.
facts.zh: 使用共享电子表格安排租赁活动设备的取货时段。

facts.en: Coordinated 28 equipment handovers during a 2026-04 festival; drivers selected their own routes.
facts.zh: 在 2026-04 的一场节庆活动中协调 28 次设备交接；司机自行选择路线。

facts.en: Recorded item counts and reported missing cases to the equipment manager.
facts.zh: 记录物品数量，并向设备经理报告缺失箱件。

facts.en: In 2026-06, built a practice dispatch board for a fictional fleet of 4 vans.
facts.zh: 2026-06，为由 4 辆货车组成的虚构车队制作练习调度看板。

facts.en: The dispatch board used invented orders and was not connected to live vehicles.
facts.zh: 该调度看板使用虚构订单，未连接实际车辆。

facts.en: Communicated revised pickup times to customers by email.
facts.zh: 通过电子邮件向客户传达更新后的取货时间。

facts.en: No transport management system use or customs documentation experience is recorded.
facts.zh: 未记录运输管理系统使用或海关文件处理经验。
